description: Fixture manifest for ArchiMate Open Exchange XML models: validation expectations, rule identifiers, and construct identifiers for CI and the scripts/archimate engine.

tiers.structural: xmllint XML Schema validation (well-formedness, element/attribute structure, xs:ID/IDREF, key/keyref constraints) against the pinned exchange schema chain
tiers.semantic: ArchiMate 3.2 metamodel validation of relationship endpoint legality and direction, implemented by scripts/archimate

fixtures.purpose: Canonical fixture covering all ArchiMate layers (Motivation, Strategy, Business, Application, Technology, Physical, Implementation & Migration), all eleven core relationship types, organization folders, property definitions, documentation, a view with nested nodes and bendpoints, and a pinned vendor extension.
Serving relationship with consumer (BusinessActor) as source and provider (ApplicationService) as target.
Composition relationship whose whole is an active structure element (BusinessActor) and whose part is a behavioral element (BusinessService).
Serving relationship whose target attribute references identifier ea-0000000000000000, declared by no element or relationship.

failure.evidence: xmllint reports no match for key-sequence ['ea-0000000000000000'] of keyref TargetRef
xmllint reports the identifier is not a valid xs:ID and ElementKey/ConceptKey identity constraints do not evaluate
